 Seven more die of dengue, 1,373 get hospitalised
 Published : 22 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 22 October 2026, 00:50
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Staff Correspondent 
 Seven more people died of dengue and 1,373 were hospitalised across the country in the 24 hours till 8:00am yesterday, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 All seven deaths were reported in Dhaka South City Corporation.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest fatalities, this year’s death toll has risen to 364, while the total number of cases has reached 1,16,990. Currently, 5,970 dengue patients are receiving treatment at hospitals nationwide.
